purpose: Online/incremental ML and concept-drift detection for challenger-only adaptive scoring and drift alarms.
latencySuitability: HIGH for per-event feature/model updates; not a market-data source
maintenance: Active public project; repository pushed 2026-08-21 and updated 2026-08-25 at review time.
docsTests: README shows code-quality workflow, maintained docs, progressive predict-then-learn examples, pipelines, online metrics and drift detection. Core interface is sample-wise and does not require pandas.
securityNotes: No credentials or external data vendor required by the core library. Native wheels are available, but development installs may require Cython/Rust; pin wheels and hashes in any sandbox benchmark.
lookAheadBiasRisk: MEDIUM if learn_one is called before the outcome label is causally available. TAGX must enforce predict -> freeze trace -> receive delayed outcome -> learn, never train on same-event future outcome.
integrationPlan: Sandbox only. Test ADWIN/Page-Hinkley drift alarms on feature distributions and a simple delayed-label online classifier against the static champion. Benchmark Time-to-Detection, Early-Capture Rate, false positives, calibration drift, CPU/memory and leakage guards before any production dependency.
